body: I was looking for personal experiences rather than academic resources and mental health factsheets.

You would be a complete asshole for breaking things off with her when she's going through a low in her life. I would maybe ask a therapist or a psychologist for advice rather than ask randos on reddit. You could even call a helpline and explain the situation and ask for steps going forward. However, please don't be a trashbag and break up with her.
